latest.title: Obata-type equations under the Bakry-Émery Ricci curvature conditions
latest.abstract: In this paper, based on the warped product structures determined by the Obata-type equations with Robin boundary condition, we establish some rigidity results for compact manifolds with smooth boundary under appropriate Bakry-Émery Ricci curvature conditions and some other assumptions.
latest.workSummary: 研究带 Robin 边界条件的 Obata 型方程，在 Bakry–Émery 曲率控制下建立紧带边流形刚性。
latest.breakthrough: 把方程决定的乘积结构用于加权边界刚性。
latest.limitations: 摘要未列齐附加假设，必须回查各定理的边界与权函数条件。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.priorityReason: 加权曲率和刚性与主线紧密相关，优先检查具体适用范围。
